install_output_empty: Akukho mveliso okwangoku. Imigca yesiphelo esuka kwisixhobo sokuhlohla iya kuvela apha.
linux_setup_welcome: Ukumisela iSP Flash Tool ye Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Ukukhuphela kunye nokuqwalasela i-injini edanyazayo enesantya esiphezulu ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela kwaye uhlaziye umdlali wakho ngaphandle komgudu.
linux_card_engine_desc: Isixhobo seMediaTek esidanyazayo esinethala leencwadi elihambelanayo.
linux_card_usb_desc: Inika imvume yedesktop yokunxibelelana nomdlali kwimowudi yeBootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
system_checker_desc: Ukuqinisekiswa okugcweleyo kwabaqhubi, iimodyuli zekernel, iimvume, kunye nethala leencwadi lexesha lokuqhuba ukuqinisekisa ukudanyaza okuthembekileyo.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Yenza ikhompyuter yakho ilungele ukunxibelelana nomdlali wakho kuhlaziyo lwesoftware.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ijonga useto lweLinux oluphambili lweSP Flash Tool, ufikelelo nge-USB, iimvume zothotho, kunye nezixhobo zesixokelelwano.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Yenza ikhompyuter yakho ilungele ukunxibelelana nomdlali wakho kwaye ufake uhlaziyo lwesoftware ngokuthembekileyo.
settings_checker_desc: Yenza ikhompyuter yakho ilungele ukunxibelelana nomdlali wakho kwaye ufake uhlaziyo lwesoftware ngokuthembekileyo.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ikhompyuter yakho ilungele ukunxibelelana nomdlali wakho.
linux_prep_blocked: Le khomputha ayinakusebenzisa isixhobo se-SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Igama lakho lokugqitha liyafuneka kube kanye ukuseta le khompyutha ukuze idanyazise: imithetho ye-USB yezixhobo zeMediaTek kunye nofikelelo lwe-serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ukuseta le khomputha yeSP Flash Tool, igama lokugqitha lakho lizakufuneka kwinyathelo elilandelayo ukuqwalasela imithetho ye-USB kunye nokongeza i-akhawunti yakho kumaqela abasebenzisi othotho afunekayo. Ukuba uyala, isicelo siya kuvala.
linux_prep_fixed: Ufikelelo lunikiwe, isixhobo se-SP Flash silungile.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Ukuseta kugqityiwe kwaye i-akhawunti yakho yongezwe kumaqela abasebenzisi afunekayo kwisixhobo se-SP Flash. Nceda uqalise kwakhona ikhompyuter yakho ukuze iimvume ezintsha zisebenze, emva koko uvule usetyenziso kwakhona. Cofa uphawu ukuze uvale i-app ngoku.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kwenziwe, Vala i-App ukuze uqalise kwakhona iKhompyutha
settings_driver_desc: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-app okokuqala, kufuneka ufake i-MediaTek umqhubi we-USB, emva koko uqalise ikhompyutha yakho.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Lungisa ngokuzenzekelayo iiMvume kunye neNkqubo yokuSeta
home_desc: Fumana i-firmware kwi-intanethi okanye ukhethe iphakheji yendawo, emva koko uyifake kwisixhobo sakho.
sel_source_desc: Khuphela i-firmware kwi-intanethi, okanye ngenisa ipakethe yendawo.
settings_advanced_desc: Ibonisa indlela yokuhlohla, imo yokufakela kunye nezihluzo zokukhulula.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: I-app ihlala nawe ngokucima, ukudibanisa, kunye nokufaka.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ivala i-Updater kwaye ivula i-SP Flash Tool GUI kunye nefayile ekhethiweyo ye-firmware yokuchithachitha kunye nemifanekiso yokwahlula elayishwe kwangaphambili.
settings_terminal_desc: Isebenzisa ufakelo lwesoftware yakho kwiSitena ukuze ubone ulwazi lobuchwephesha kwinkqubela phambili.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Iqhuba ufakelo lwakho lwesoftware kwiCommand Prompt ukuze ukwazi ukubona ulwazi lobuchwephesha kwinkqubela phambili.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Ukhetho. Ezinye iithagethi zeMediaTek ziyala ukudanyaza de iSP Flash Tool inikwe uqinisekiso (.auth) ifayile; Yongeza eyakho apha ukuba isixhobo sifuna enye.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Akukho fayile yokuchithachitha ifunyenwe kule phakheji, ngoko ke akukho myalelo we-console unokwakhiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Akukho SP Flash Tool yakha okanye indawo yokungena yeMTKClient ekhoyo ngale ndlela.
terminal_install_failed: Ayikwazanga ukuvula ifestile yendlela. Umyalelo wokuhlohla wawubhalelwe {path}.
status_terminal_install: Faka umyalelo ovuliweyo kwi-terminal window yakho ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ngoku iza kuvula ibaleka {method}.

• Ukuba ayikacinywa, cima {device} yakho.
• Ukuba iqhagamshelwe kwi-USB, yikhuphe kuqala.
{hint}
• Qhagamshela isixhobo sakho kwikhompyuter yakho xa {terminal_name} ifestile ivuliwe.

Cofa u-OK ukuze uqalise kwaye uphume kwi-Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Ingcebiso: Ukuba ifowuni ayiqhagamsheleki ngokuzenzekelayo, cofa ngobunono iqhosha lokuseta ngokutsha kumngxuma wokuqhafaza nge-paperclip ngelixa uqhagamshela intambo ye-USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Ingcebiso: Beka isixhobo sakho kwimowudi yokukhuphela i-firmware (iyahluka ngokwemodeli: umz. susa ibhetri kwaye uyigcine ngaphandle ngentambo ye-USB eqhagamshelwe, okanye cima ngebhetri ngaphakathi, okanye ubambe iVolume Down/Up xa uqhagamshela i-USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI ngoku iza kuvula firmware yakho elayishwe kwangaphambili.

• Kwisixhobo se-SP Flash, khetha u-"Khuphela" kwibhokisi eyehlayo.
• Cofa iqhosha elithi "Khuphela".
• Qinisekisa ukuba i-{device} yakho icinyiwe kwaye iqhawukile.
{hint}
• Qhagamshela intambo ye-USB kwikhompyuter yakho emva kokucofa Khuphela.

Cofa u-Kulungile ukuze uqalise i-SP Flash Tool kwaye uphume kwi-Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Xa yenziwe yasebenza, imixholo ye-Rockbox ithunyelwa ngokuzenzekelayo kwi-Y1 kunye ne-Y2 emva kofakelo oluyimpumelelo lwe-Rockbox.
themes_placement_failed_note: Asikwazanga ukubeka ipakethi yemixholo kumdlali wakho. Ungazama kwakhona kwiiSetingi.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Bonisa i-Software yoqobo ekhuphayo endala kuno-3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Ukukhutshwa kweSoftware yoqobo ekudala kune-3.0.7 ayihambelani neeyunithi zeY1 ezithengiswa nge-Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Ukudanyazisa ulwakhiwo oludala kwezi yunithi kuya kuzithintela ekuqaliseni ide inguqulelo entsha ibuyiselwe.

Ngaba uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukubonisa ukukhutshwa kweSoftware yeNdawo endala kuno-3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Ibonisa izakhiwo ezizip ye-ROM ibe ngumahluko we-240p (rom…_240p.zip). Ulwakhiwo lwe-240p aluhambelani neeyunithi ze-Y1 kwi-Innioasis OS ngaphantsi kwe-3.0.7, ngoko ke Bonisa i-Old Rockbox Builds inikwe amandla nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ukukhutshwa kwe-Rockbox-Y1 ngaphambi kwe-0.5 ayihambelani neeyunithi ze-Y1 ezithengiswa emva koMatshi ka-2026 kunye ne-Innioasis OS 3.0.7 efakwe ngaphambili.

Ukukhanyisa isakhiwo esidala kwezi zixhobo kuya kuthintela ukuqala.

Uqinisekile ukuba ufuna ukubonisa ulwakhiwo oludala lweRockbox?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nceda ukhethe i-.zip, .rar yokugcina, okanye ifayile yokusasaza (*sasaza*.txt) ngaphakathi kwefolda ye-firmware ukuze ufake i-firmware oyikhethileyo kwi-{target} yakho.
sel_offline: Uluhlu olukwi-intanethi alukho ngoku. Sebenzisa ifayile yendawo, okanye jonga umdibaniso wakho.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Iiphakheji ezininzi ze-firmware okanye iifayile zokusasaza zifunyenwe kule folda/indawo yokugcina. Nceda khetha isiqulathi seefayili okanye indawo yokugcina equlathe kuphela iphakheji ye-firmware enye ngexesha.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Olu khupho luqulathe ngaphezulu kwefayile enye yokuchithachitha, ngoko ke uMhlaziyi akanakuxela ukuba loluphi ubeko olufunwa ngumdlali wakho. Umphuhlisi we-{software} uya kufuna ukuhlaziya ukukhutshwa kwe-firmware ukuze abandakanye kuphela ifayile enye yokuchithachitha.
sp_search_restart: Akukho sixhobo okwangoku, kukhangelwa kwakhona (umzamo {count}). Gcina umdlali evaliwe kwaye uqhagamshele xa ucelwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Ifayile yoqinisekiso ayifunyenwanga ({path}); edanyazayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Ifayile yokuchithachitha ayibhengezi iqonga layo, ngoko ke uqwalaselo lweconsole lwefayile yoqinisekiso alunakwakhiwa. edanyazayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Ifayile yokuchithachitha ayibhengezi uhlobo logcino (EMMC/NAND/UFS), ngoko ke uqwalaselo lweconsole lwefayile yoqinisekiso alunakwakhiwa; edanyazayo ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Akukho fayile yokungqinisisa enikiweyo; ukudanyaza ngaphandle komnye.
sp_config_write_failed: Ayinakubhala ifayile yoqwalaselo lwe console. idanyaza ngaphandle kwefayile yesiqinisekiso.
settings_notifications_desc: Bonisa izaziso zesistim yesaziso kunye neentlobo zohlaziyo ezingezantsi. Cima igcina yonke into ngaphakathi kwi-app.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Uhlobo luhlaziyo lwehardware yomdlali. Abadlali bemodeli efanayo banokwakhiwa ngaphezu kokuhlaziywa kwesinye - umzekelo Uhlobo lwe-A kunye noHlobo lwe-B - kunye nesofthiwe yenzelwe omnye wabo. Qwalasela isincamathelisi ngasemva komdlali; ukuba ayichazi uhlobo, shiya ukhetho lokuqala.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Akukho zinguqulelo zikhoyo kule software ngoku.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gcina i-app kwibar yemenyu emva kokuba ifestile ivaliwe, ukuze ufumane usetyenziso kunye nomdlali we-firmware izaziso. Valiwe: ukuvala ifestile kuyayiyeka i-app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gcina i-app kwitreyi yenkqubo emva kokuba ifestile ivaliwe, ukuze ufumane izaziso zohlaziyo lwe-app kunye nomdlali we-firmware. Valiwe: ukuvala ifestile kuyayiyeka i-app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Fihla ikhathalogu yoluntu kwi-intanethi kwaye ufake isoftware kwiifayile zasekhaya kuphela.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ukhanyise i-360p ye-Rockbox yokwakha. Ngaba ungathanda ukufaka i-360p Theme Pack kwesi sixhobo ngoku?
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nceda qhawula uqhagamshelo lwe-USB, vula amandla kwaye uqalise kwi-Rockbox kanye (ngoko iqalisa ifolda yayo yangaphakathi .rockbox yesixokelelwano), emva koko uqhagamshele i-USB kwaye ukhethe 'Imo YokuGcina i-USB'.

Xa uqhagamshelwe, cofa Qhubeka ukukhetha nasiphi na isiqulathi seefayili kumdlali wakho.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Khetha nayiphi na ifolda kwindawo yokugcina umdlali eqhagamshelweyo
sel_themepack_success: I-Rockbox Theme Pack ifakwe ngempumelelo kwisixhobo sakho!
sel_only_local: Khetha iphakheji ye-.zip okanye ye-.rar ye-firmware, okanye ifolda / ifayile ye-.txt, ukufakwa ngaphandle kweintanethi, akukho intanethi efunekayo. Isebenza ngayo yonke i-Innioasis kunye nomdlali we-audio we-Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Khetha iphakheji ye-firmware yasekhaya (.zip, .rar) okanye ifolda equlethe ifayile yokuchithachitha ukufakwa ngaphandle kweintanethi, isebenza kunye nezixhobo eziqhelekileyo zeMediaTek.
sel_offline_install: Faka i-firmware kwifayile ye-.zip okanye .rar kuyo nayiphi na i-Innioasis okanye umdlali we-audio we-Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Faka i-firmware kwi-.zip/.rar yokugcina okanye ifolda ye-firmware kwizixhobo eziqhelekileyo zeMediaTek.
sel_update_available: Kukho uhlaziyo ku-{software} olufumanekayo ukwenzela {model} yakho.
conn_offline: Awukho kwi-intanethi. Ufakelo olusuka kuVimba weFirmware yoLuntu alukho.
conn_archive_unavailable: Ikhathalogu ye-firmware ayifumaneki okwethutyana. Usenako ukuhlohla kwindawo yokugcina okanye iifayile zasekuhlaleni.
single_instance_body: Enye ikopi ivuliwe, okanye isasebenza ngasemva. Iikopi ezimbini ziya kukhuphisana kuqhagamshelo lwe-USB lomdlali, ke le ayizukuqala.
single_instance_focus_failed: Ikopi ebalekayo ayiphendulanga isicelo sokubonisa ifestile yayo. Isenokuba ixakekile okanye ijinga. Ukunyanzela ukuyiyeka kuya kuphazamisa nantoni na eyifakayo.
single_instance_force_failed: Ukopisho olusebenzayo alukwazanga ukupheliswa. Yiyeke ngokwakho, emva koko uqalise ukuhlaziya kwakhona.
single_instance_busy_body: Ikopi esebenzayo ifaka isoftware okanye ukuthetha nomdlali, ukuyiphelisa ngoku kuya kuyiphazamisa loo nto. Oku kuphehlelelwa kuya kuvala; sebenzisa iwindow ekhoyo okanye i icon yebar yemenyu xa ukufakwa kugqityiwe.
toast_battery_charged: Phambi kokuba usebenzise oku kumdlali wakho, tshaja ibhetri kangangeyure ubuncinane
toast_battery_charged_device: Phambi kokuba usebenzise oku kwisixhobo sakho, tshaja ibhetri kangangeyure ubuncinane
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Yenza izaziso zangasemva zisebenze ukuze ufumane uhlaziyo kwaye ukhuphe izilumkiso naxa isiHlaziyi sivaliwe kwibar yemenyu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Vumela izaziso zangasemva ukufumana uhlaziyo kwaye ukhuphe izilumkiso naxa isiHlaziyi sivaliwe kwitreyi yesixokelelwano.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Iinkonzo zokuguqulela kwi-Intanethi azifikeleleki okwangoku okanye zipholile. Amanqaku okukhutshwa kokuqala aya kuboniswa endaweni yoko.
translate_unavailable_hint: Inguqulelo ayifumaneki okwangoku. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi yakho okanye uzame kwakhona kamva.
flash_wait_desc: Cima isixhobo kuqala. Ukuba iqhagamshelwe kodwa ayibonwa, zama intambo ye-USB eyahlukileyo okanye izibuko.
dialog_pre_install_header: Nceda uqinisekise ukuba i-{model} yakho icinyiwe kwaye ayidityaniswanga yi-USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Sicime ngokupheleleyo isixhobo sakho phambi kokuba uqalise.
• Ukuba ifowuni ingumkhenkce okanye ayiphenduli, sebenzisa iphini okanye i-paperclip kumngxunya wokuseta ngokutsha ukunyanzela ukucima umbane kwimowudi yokukhuphela.
• Gcina intambo ye-USB ivaliwe okwangoku.
• Cofa Qhubeka, emva koko uqhagamshele isixhobo sakho nge-USB xa uyalelwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Sicime ngokupheleleyo isixhobo sakho seMediaTek.
• Gcina intambo ye-USB ivaliwe okwangoku.
• Ngokuxhomekeke kwimodeli, zama ukudibanisa okanye ngaphandle kwebhetri efakiweyo (okanye ubambe iVolume Down / Up ngelixa uqhagamshela).
• Cofa Qhubeka, uze uqhagamshele intambo ye-USB xa uyalelwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Asikwazi ukugcina idatha yakho yokuhlohla kuba i-firmware yakho yangoku ayihambelani neGcina iData.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Nqamula intambo ye-USB kwaye usebenzise i-paperclip okanye i-pin ukucofa iqhosha lokuseta kwakhona, uze uzame ukuqhagamshela kwakhona.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Kucetyiswa ukuba udibanise umdlali kwitshaja eludongeni imizuzu engama-30 ukuya kwiyure ngaphambi kokuba uzame ukudibanisa.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • IiPC zeWindows kufuneka ziphinde ziqaliswe emva kokufaka umqhubi phambi kokusetyenziswa kokuqala.
keep_data_running_fmt: Ngaba i-{software} sele ifakiwe kwi-{model} yakho?
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Ngaba isoftware sele ifakiwe kwi {model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware: Yeyiphi isoftware esebenzayo ngoku kwi-{model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Ukuba awuqinisekanga, khetha 'Okunye' okanye isoftwe ocinga ukuba ifakiwe.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Ukuqhubeka nokuhlohla, nceda uqinisekise ukuba {model} yakho sele iqhuba isoftwe esisiseko efunekayo ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Sinokugcina useto lwakho kunye nemidiya xa umdlali sele eqhuba le software okanye inguqulelo ehambelanayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Sinokugcina useto lwakho kuphela xa umdlali sele eqhuba le software okanye inguqulelo ehambelanayo.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Sinokugcina useto lwakho kunye nemidiya xa umdlali sele eqhuba le software okanye inguqulelo ehambelanayo.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Vumela Gcina iiSetingi kunye neMedia kuyo nayiphi na i-firmware efakelweyo
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Utsiba umbuzo wokuhambelana. Sebenzisa oku kuphela xa uqinisekile ukuba umdlali uya kuhlala esebenza ngoseto lwangoku kunye nemidiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Ayikwazanga ukugcina useto lwakho kunye nemidiya: ifolda ye-firmware ayibhaleki. Akukho nto ifakiweyo.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Ugcina useto lwakho kunye nemidiya kumdlali. Eminye isoftware ifakwe njengesiqhelo.
flash_keep_data_warning: Ukuba uqhubeka ngaphandle koku, useto lwakho kunye nemidiya iya kuphinda ibekwe kwindawo yokugcina yangaphakathi yomdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Ukuba uyaqhubeka ngaphandle koku, imixholo yakho yeRockbox, iifonti kunye noseto luya kususwa. Umculo wakho kunye nezinye imidiya ziya kuhlala kumdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Ukuba uqhubeka ngaphandle koku, imixholo yakho ye-Rockbox, iifonti kunye nezicwangciso ziya kususwa, kwaye ugcino lwangaphakathi lomdlali luya kuphinda lubekwe kwakhona.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Ukuba uyaqhubeka ngaphandle koku, useto lwakho luzakusetwa ngokutsha. Umculo wakho kunye nezinye imidiya ziya kuhlala kumdlali.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Le firmware kufuneka iguqule ugcino lwangaphakathi lomdlali. Useto olugciniweyo luya kucinywa; umculo wakho kunye nezinye imidiya ziya kuhlala endaweni.
format_all_data_warning_other: Le firmware kufuneka iguqule ugcino lwangaphakathi lomdlali. Useto olugciniweyo kunye nemidiya egcinwe kwindawo yokugcina eyakhelwe-ngaphakathi iya kucinywa. Imidiya kwi-microSD yakho ihlala isendaweni.
format_all_confirm_body:
Kwi-{software} kufuneka silungise ngokutsha {model} ugcino lwakho lwangaphakathi phambi kokuba siqhubeke. Emva koko enye inzame ye-SP Flash Tool iya kuzama, kodwa kwiFomathi Yonke + Imowudi yokuKhuphela nge-XML console-mode run.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Susa uqhagamshelo lwe-USB, emva koko faka i-paperclip okanye iphini kumngxuma wokuseta kwakhona kwi-{model} yakho. Cofa Okulandelayo ukuze uzame kwakhona kwiFomathi Zonke + Imo yokukhuphela.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool ingxelo ukuba itafile ukwahlula umdlali yatshintsha (8502). Le firmware kufuneka ifakwe kwiFomathi Yonke + Imowudi yokuKhuphela, elungisa ngokutsha ukugcinwa kwangaphakathi.
install_first_hint: Ngaphambi kokuseta {target} okokuqala, {model} yakho kufuneka isebenze {software} — okanye {target} ngokwayo, ukuba sele ifakiwe kwaye iyasebenza.
install_first_version_fmt: Ngaba i-{model} yakho sele ihlangabezane neemfuno {software} ({version})?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Nceda uqhawule i-USB, vula i-{model} yakho kwaye ucofe Okulandelayo.
install_first_power_on_hint: Vumela umdlali aqale kube kanye kwisiseko se-firmware, emva koko uyicime kwi-install elandelayo.
install_first_need_body: {target} isebenza kakuhle xa uqala nge {software} kwi {model} yakho. Siza kuhlohla {software} kuqala, emva koko siqhubeke siye {target} ngokuzenzekelayo.
install_first_when_body: {target} akufuneki ifakwe ngqo ngaphezulu {running}: kwi-{model} yakho umdlali akayi kuqalisa kakuhle emva koko. Ukufakela {software} kuqala yindlela ekhuselekileyo, kwaye {target} ilandele ngokuzenzekelayo.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} akufuneki ifakwe ngqo phezu kwesoftware esele ikwi {model}: umdlali akayi kuqalisa kakuhle emva koko. Ukufakela {software} kuqala yindlela ekhuselekileyo, kwaye {target} ilandele ngokuzenzekelayo.

support_story_1_headline: Xa abavelisi beqhubela phambili, uluntu luyanyuka.
support_story_1_lead: Ukukhusela isixhobo sakho kwimigibe ye-hardware ethuleyo kunye nohlaziyo olwaphukileyo.
support_story_1_body: I-Innioasis ihlala ikhupha ii-firmwares ezintsha zabadlali abafana ne-Y1 (ijolise ekuhlaziyweni kwebhodi efihliweyo njenge-6.0, 7.0, kunye ne-8.0) ezophula ngokuthe cwaka izixhobo ezindala. Okubi nakakhulu, iwebhusayithi yabo ibonelela ngezilumkiso zero kunye nokufikelela kwi-zero kwii-firmwares zangaphambili zokusebenza ukuze uphinde ubuyele kwimeko yezitena. Uhlaziyo lwe-CE kunye neprojekthi yeFirmware yasekuhlaleni ithatha amaqhekeza: sigcina zonke ii-ROM zelifa, siqinisekisa ngokuzenzekelayo uhlaziyo lwakho lwezixhobo, kwaye ugcine umdlali wakho ebaleka ngokukhuselekileyo.
support_story_1_item_1: Ukuhlangula Abadlali Abaphukileyo: Iitshekhi zokhuseleko ziqinisekisa uhlaziyo olutsha alusoze lwenze ngezitena zehardware endala.
support_story_1_item_2: IiROM ezigciniweyo zesitokhwe: Ingqokelela epheleleyo yeefirmwares zasefektri i-Innioasis icinyiwe.
support_story_1_item_3: I-Native Cross-Platform: Izixhobo ezidanyazayo ezigcweleyo zeMacOS, Linux, kunye neWindows ngokufanayo.
support_story_1_item_4: I-Hardware Intelligence: Ukubonwa kwebhodi okuzenzekelayo ukuze uhlale ufumana iphakheji efanelekileyo.
support_story_2_headline: Akukho kwaGoogle Drives ezaphukileyo. Akukho msebenzi wokuqikelela. I-firmware esebenzayo nje.
support_story_2_lead: Isantya esiphezulu, isiseko soluntu esiqinisekisiweyo onokuthi uxhomekeke kuso.
support_story_2_body: Ukulandelela phantsi isoftware ye-Innioasis esemthethweni ngokuqhelekileyo kuthetha ukuba iiforam zokukhangela amakhonkco eDrayivu kaGoogle aphelelwe lixesha, izabelo zelifu le-Baidu ezifileyo, kunye neefayile ze-zip eziyimfihlakalo ezingenazixhobo ezidanyazayo. Sakhe uthungelwano lokukhuphela oluthembekileyo, oluzimeleyo ngokuthembeka kwe-SHA-256 eqinisekisiweyo, izaziso zohlaziyo, kunye nofakelo olukhokelwa ngamanyathelo. Iminikelo yakho igcina ngokuthe ngqo okukhutshelweyo kunye nokusingathwa okwenza oku kwenzeke iiyure ezingama-24 ngosuku, iintsuku ezingama-365 ngonyaka.
support_story_2_item_1: I-CDN enesantya esiphezulu esithe ngqo: Ukukhuphela ngokukhawuleza, ngokuthe ngqo ngaphandle kwemida yokukhuphela okanye amakhonkco afileyo.
support_story_2_item_2: Izaziso zohlaziyo: Yaziswa ngalo mzuzu ukukhutshwa koluntu olutsha okanye ukwehla kwezilungiso.
support_story_2_item_3: UFakelo lweNyathelo-ngeNyathelo oluKhokelweyo: Sula iimpembelelo ezibonwayo zikuhambise kulo lonke ucofa amaqhosha.
support_story_2_item_4: Uluntu oluthetha iilwimi ezininzi: Ifakwe ngokupheleleyo kwisiNgesi, isiTshayina, isiJamani, iSpanish, isiFrentshi kunye nesiJapani.
support_story_3_headline: Ukuvula amandla apheleleyo omdlali wakho we-Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Ukuzisa i-Rockbox, iisistim ezilula, kunye nenkululeko ye-audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Isoftware yemveliso yempahla ikrwela kuphela umphezulu wento enokwenziwa yiY1 okanye iY2 hardware yakho. Uluntu lwethu luzise iRockbox, iisistim ezilula ezisebenzayo, i-audiophile codec yokudlala, kunye nemixholo yesiko ebomini. Sithenga ukwahluka kwehardware ebonakalayo ngaphandle kwepokotho yokuvavanya, ukubuyisela umva injineli, kunye nokuqinisekisa ukufakela ngakunye. Ukuxhasa uHlaziyo lwe-CE luxhasa ngokuthe ngqo ezi yunithi zovavanyo kwaye ikhawulezisa uphuhliso lwe-firmware yesiko.
support_story_3_item_1: Cofa i-Rockbox enye: Ukudlala kwakhona kwe-audiophile kunye nemixholo yesiko efakwe kwimizuzwana.
support_story_3_item_2: I-Firmware yoLuntu: Ukongezwa kwebhetri, i-UI ecocekileyo, kunye nenkxaso yekhowudi ye-audio yanamhlanje.
support_story_3_item_3: ILabhu yeHardware esebenzayo: Sivavanya kwizixhobo zokwenyani zokwenyani ngaphambi kokuba sikhulule nasiphi na isakhiwo.
support_story_3_item_4: I-Zero Bloatware: I-100% yasimahla, isoftware yabucala yokuqala ngaphandle kweentengiso okanye umkhondo.
support_story_4_lead: Ugcino lwe-firmware olunamandla oluntu olugcina izixhobo zakho ngaphandle kwenkunkuma.
support_story_4_body: Xa inkampani yehardware ihambela kwigajethi yayo elandelayo, iimodeli ezindala ziyalahlwa. I-Innioasis ayiboneleli ngenkxaso ye-Linux, akukho tshintsho olucacileyo, kwaye akukho ndlela ilula yokubuyisela xa ukufakwa kusilela. Uhlaziyo lwe-CE lukhona kuba abasebenzisi abanomdla akufuneki balahle umdlali womculo olungileyo. I-100% yeminikelo yoluntu iya ngqo ekugcineni esi sixhobo sivulekele wonke umntu.
support_story_4_item_1: Ukuhlangula kunye ne-Unbrick: Ukubuyiswa okuqinisekisiweyo kuyahamba nokuba izixhobo ziyala ukuqala.
support_story_4_item_2: Inkxaso yeKlasi yokuQala yeLinux: Ixhaswe ngokupheleleyo iMediaTek edanyazayo kwiLinux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Utshintsho olucacileyo: Amanqaku okukhutshwa aneenkcukacha ukuze wazi kakuhle ukuba loluphi utshintsho.
support_story_4_item_4: I-100% ifumana inkxaso-mali kuluntu: Yonke ikofu igcina indawo yokugcina ivuliwe kwaye isimahla kumntu wonke.
support_methods_subtitle: Khetha indlela yomnikelo oyikhethayo. Yonke iminikelo ixhasa ngokuthe ngqo ukukhutshelwa, ukusingathwa, kunye novavanyo lwehardware.

sel_install_tooltip_generic: Faka inkqubo yenkqubo ekhethiweyo kwisixhobo sakho
linux_engine_staged_desc: Isixhobo se-MediaTek SP Flash sibekwe ngokuhambelana ne-libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Cofa kwakhona ukujonga okanye uqalise ukuseta ukukhuphela ipakethe.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Imithetho yeMediaTek esebenzayo (/etc/udev/rules.d/). Ufikelelo lweDesktop luvuliwe.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Nika iimvume kube kanye ukuze i-app inxibelelane nesixhobo sakho.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Iimvume ze-USB kunye nemithetho ye-udev efakwe ngempumelelo. Iinkonzo ziqwalaselwe.
donate_rely_on_you: Sincede ngeendleko zethu zokusebenza, nikela namhlanje.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vula iMediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: Usetyenziso lusetwe ngokutsha luze lugqibeke, ukukhuphela i-cache kucinyiwe, kwaye isikhumbuzi sebhetri sibuyiselwe.
log_app_reset_defaults: Ulungelelwaniso lwe-app lusetwe ngokutsha luyinkqubo, ukukhuphela i-cache kucinyiwe, kunye nesikhumbuzi sebhetri sibuyiselwe (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ilindele ukuba umdlali wakho aqale kwakhona...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Yigcine iplagi, i-Rockbox iyaqala kwaye imixholo yayo iya kongezelelwa ngokuzenzekelayo.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Jonga ukuba iplagiwe kwaye ilayitiwe. Ukuba ihlala imnyama, cofa iqhoshana kumngxunya wokusetha ngokutsha kwaye ubambe iqhosha eliphakathi (Y1) okanye iqhosha lamandla (abanye abadlali) ukuyiqalisa kwakhona. Ukuba ayisayi kuqalisa, i-firmware ayizange ithathe, faka enye.
action_flash_complete: Ukukhanya kugqityiwe! Nqamula i-USB kwaye uqalise kwakhona.
action_recover_powercycle: Umjikelo wamandla umdlali (bamba amandla ~10s), emva koko uqhagamshele kwakhona - uzama kwakhona...
action_wait_mtk: Ilinde isixhobo seMTK... Cima isixhobo kwaye uqhagamshele i-USB.
action_da_stall: Isixhobo siyekile ukuphendula xa siqwalasela iarhente yokukhuphela. Yicime ngokupheleleyo, qhagamshela kwakhona, kwaye uzame kwakhona.
action_detected_brom: Isixhobo sichongiwe (imo ye-BROM) - ukuqwalasela i-arhente yokukhuphela...
action_detected_preloader: Isixhobo sichongiwe (imowudi yokulayishwa kwangaphambili) - ukuqwalasela iarhente yokukhuphela...
action_da_wait_back: Umdlali uyekile ukuphendula ngelixa eqala iarhente yokukhuphela. Ilinde ukuba ibuye...
log_sparse_fmt: Ichongiwe umfanekiso ongephi we-Android we-{part}, uguqulela kwinkqubo...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Uqinisekiso lwetheyibhile yolwahlulo aluphumelelanga emva kokubhala
err_sp_wrong_model: Uqhagamshele imodeli engalunganga yomdlali. Cofa iqhosha × ukurhoxisa olu fakelo, emva koko ukhethe isoftwe yomdlali oqhagamshelene nayo.
err_sp_timeout: Isixhobo asizange simbone umdlali. Yigcine ivaliwe kwaye ikhutshiwe, emva koko uqhagamshele intambo ye-USB xa uyalelwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umdlali unikwe amandla kwangoko kakhulu. Yicime ngokupheleleyo, emva koko uyidibanise kwakhona.
err_sp_download_fail: Ukubhala kwaphazamiseka. Jonga intambo ye-USB kunye nesibuko kunye nentlawulo yebhetri, uze uzame kwakhona.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Iarhente yokukhuphela ayikwazanga ukuqalisa. Zama enye indlela yokudanyaza.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Iarhente yokukhuphela ayikwazanga kuthunyelwa kumdlali. Yicime kwaye uqhagamshele kwakhona.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Umdlali wala iarhente yokukhuphela (impazamo 6104). Sebenzisa iArhente yokuKhuphela edityaniswe nesixhobo se-SP Flash, kwaye khangela ukuba i-firmware ihambelana nalo mdlali.
err_sp_com_port: Isixhobo asikwazanga ukuvula uthotho lwaso lwezibuko. Vala ezinye izixhobo ezidanyazayo kwaye uqhagamshele kwakhona.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: I-USB COM port ayikwazanga ukuvulwa (impazamo 1013). Ukuqalisa kwakhona ikhompyuter yakho kuya kukhulula izibuko ezitshixiweyo. Nceda uqalise ikhompyuter yakho kwaye uzame kwakhona.
err_sp_enable_dram: Isixhobo asikwazanga ukuqalisa imemori yomdlali. Sebenzisa ipakethe eyakhelweyo le modeli ichanekileyo.
err_sp_storage_read: Isixhobo asikwazanga ukufunda ugcino lomdlali. Jonga umdibaniso; isixhobo sinokuba nempazamo kwihardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Isixhobo esidanyazayo asikhange sibonise nkqubela phambili phakathi kwemizuzwana {seconds}, ngoko ke lo mzamo uye wanqunyanyiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ayikwazanga ukuseka uqhagamshelwano oluzinzileyo nomdlali. Qinisekisa ukuba isixhobo sivaliwe (sebenzisa iphini ukucofa iqhosha lokuseta kwakhona ukuba kukho imfuneko), cima i-USB, kwaye uqhagamshele kwakhona xa uyalelwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ukudanyaza kuphazamisekile okanye umsebenzi wokubhala awuphumelelanga. Jonga ukuba intambo ye-USB iplagwe ngokuqinileyo kwaye nebhetri inentlawulo eyaneleyo, uze uzame kwakhona.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Isixhobo esikhanyayo sibonise umgca ofanayo wokugqibela {seconds} imizuzwana kwaye ayibonakali iqhubeka nokubhala i-firmware. Umbane unokusilela. Ukuba le ibiyeyokugqibela kwimizamo emibini ngendlela nganye kwindlela enokuthi ibuye phakathi kwayo, okanye ukuba kuphela iMTKClient ekhoyo kulo matshini, qalisa kwakhona ikhompyutha kwaye uzame kwakhona.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Kuphela yiMTKClient ekhoyo kolu fakelo. Umbane unokusilela. Nceda uqalise kwakhona ikhompyutha kwaye uzame kwakhona.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Le khompyutha inokufakela kwakhona usebenzisa iSP Flash Tool. Ukuba unako, tshintshela kwi-SP Flash Tool kwaye uzame kwakhona.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Umbane unokusilela. Nceda ufunde lo myalezo ungasentla kwaye uqalise kwakhona ikhompyutha phambi kokuba uzame kwakhona. Ukuba ucofa u-Kulungile, i-app iya kuyeka ukuze uqalise kwakhona.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iphakheji ye-firmware ilahlekile ifayile yokuchithachitha okanye iifayile zemifanekiso ezifunekayo. Nceda ukhuphele kwakhona ipakethe okanye ukhethe ifayile ye-firmware epheleleyo.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Ifayile yoqinisekiso oyikhethileyo ayikho, ayinanto okanye ayibhalwanga. Khetha ifayile esebenzayo, okanye uyicime kwiiSetingi, uze udanyaze kwakhona.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Isixhobo esidanyazayo okanye abaqhubi benkqubo efunekayo abakwazanga kuqalwa. Nceda ujonge iimvume zesixokelelwano, useto lomqhubi, okanye ubuyisele usetyenziso.
err_driver_missing_desc: Le mpazamo inokwenzeka xa umqhubi we-MediaTek USB engafakwanga. Cofa Khuphela Abaqhubi ukufaka i-MediaTek umqhubi we-USB, qala kwakhona ikhompyuter yakho, kwaye uzame kwakhona.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Ifayile ye-firmware egciniweyo ayikho. Khetha Khetha iSoftware ukwakha kwakhona iifayile ezikhutshiweyo okanye ukhuphele i-archive ye-firmware kwakhona. Le yingxaki yefayile yendawo, hayi umba woqhagamshelo lwe-USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Buyela kuKhetha iSoftware ukuze wakhe kwakhona okanye ukhuphele iphakheji ye-firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Khetha ukukhutshwa kwe-firmware ukuze ukhuphele kwakhona.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kwenzeke impazamo engalindelekanga ngexesha lofakelo ({detail}). Mcime ngokupheleleyo umdlali, phinda uqhagamshele xa ucelwa, kwaye uzame kwakhona.
flash_method_confirm: Indlela yokufaka itshintshelwe ku-{method}. Qinisekisa ukuba umdlali ukhutshiwe kwaye ucinyiwe, uze ucofe Okulandelayo.
flash_failover_note: {method} khange iqalise ukufakela. Emva kokuba umdlali ecinyiwe kwaye ekhutshiwe, {other} iya kusetyenziswa endaweni yoko.
themepack_card_desc: Ibandakanya imixholo emihle yasekuhlaleni, i-backdrops ephezulu, kunye neefonti ezenzelwe ngokukodwa iziboniso ze-360p.
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Vula umdlali wakho ngokubamba iqhosha laMandla.
2. Xa iibhutsi zeRockbox, qhaga intambo ye-USB kwikhompyuter yakho.
3. Ukuba uyalelwe kwisikrini somdlali, qinisekisa imowudi yoGcino lwe-USB ukuze isixhobo sivele njengedrive.
themepack_step2_title: Inyathelo 2: Khetha Nasiphi na isiqulathi seefayili kuMdlali
themepack_step2_desc: Ngenxa yokuba iinkqubo zokusebenza (ezifana ne-macOS) zifihla iifayile ze-dot (njenge-.rockbox) ngokungagqibekanga, ungakhetha NAPHI na ifolda okanye ingcambu yedrayivu kumdlali wakho. Siza kukufunela ngokuzenzekelayo okanye sikwenzele uvimba weefayili we-.rockbox.
themepack_complete: Ipakethi yomxholo ifakwe ngempumelelo! Ngoku ungaqhawula ngokukhuselekileyo umdlali wakho kwaye ukhethe umxholo kwiRockbox (Useto > Useto lomxholo).
themepack_err_not_found: Ayikwazanga ukufumana okanye iqalise ulawulo lwe-.rockbox kwidrive ekhethiweyo. Nceda uqinisekise ukuba ukhethe isiqulathi seefayili kumdlali wakho.
rockbox_wizard_title: I-Rockbox ye-360p imixholo kunye nokuSeta iifonti
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Inyathelo 1: Qala kwakhona umdlali kwaye uqhagamshele kwakhona
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Nqamula intambo ye-USB.
2. Amandla omdlali emva kwaye uyivumele iqale kwi-Rockbox.
3. Nje ukuba i-Rockbox isebenze, qhagamshela kwakhona intambo ye-USB, uze ucinezele Qhubeka.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: I-app ibukele uqhagamshelwano lwe-ADB (ukuya kwimizuzwana engama-30). Ukuba isixhobo sifunyenwe, imixholo idluliswa kwaye umdlali uqaliswe ngokuzenzekelayo. Ngaphandle koko, tsibela phambili kwiMowudi yokuGcina i-USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Akukho sixhobo se-ADB esifunyenweyo kwimizuzwana engama-30; iqhubekeka ngeMowudi yoGcino lwe-USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Akukho kokubini kwe-ADB ekhoyo kwi-app; iqhubekeka ngeMowudi yoGcino lwe-USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Ukutyhala imixholo kunye neefonti ngaphezulu kwe-ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Udluliselo lwe-ADB aluphumelelanga; ukuwela umva kwiMowudi yoGcino lwe-USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Yenza iMowudi yoGcino lwe-USB kumdlali ukuze ibonakale njengedrive.
2. Khetha NAPHI na ifolda kumdlali ongezantsi (.rockbox, Music, Themes, okanye i-drive root, ifolda efihliweyo ye-rockbox ibekwe ngokuzenzekelayo).
3. I-app idibanisa imixholo ye-360p kunye neefonti, ibhala ngaphezulu iifayile zegama elifanayo.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Ngoku ungaqhawula ngokukhuselekileyo umdlali kwaye ukhethe umxholo kwi-Rockbox (Useto> Useto lomxholo).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Isoftware yakho entsha ifakiwe, kodwa isiqulathi seefayili esidala se-.rockbox asikwazanga kususwa. Cima ifolda ye-rockbox kumdlali ngesandla ukuba ufuna isiqalo esicocekileyo.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Ngaphezulu komdlali omnye uqhagamshelwe. Nqamula ezinye kwaye ushiye kuphela le ifakiweyo.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umdlali uchongiwe. Ukubeka imixholo yoluntu kunye neefonti...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Bamba iqhosha eliphakathi ukuze unike amandla kwi-Y1 yakho, phinda uqhagamshele i-USB, kwaye ukhethe Imo yokuGcina i-USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Bamba iqhosha lamandla ukunika amandla kumdlali wakho, phinda uqhagamshele i-USB, kwaye ukhethe Imo yokuGcina i-USB.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Nceda uqhawule kwaye uvule i-{model} yakho, emva koko ucinezele Okulandelayo
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Susa uqhagamshelwano lwe-USB, ubambe i-{button} ukuze uvule {model}, uze ucinezele Okulandelayo.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Qhagamshela i-{model} yakho nge-USB, uyivule, emva koko ucinezele Okulandelayo.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Nceda ukhethe umdlali ngokwawo okanye ifolda ye-.rockbox
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nceda uvule imowudi yokugcina i-USB kwisixhobo sakho kwaye ucofe Okulandelayo
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Nceda uvule imowudi yogcino lwe-USB kwi-{model} yakho, emva koko ukhethe idrayivu evelayo
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Nceda khetha umdlali ngokwakhe okanye enye yeefolda ezikuyo
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Nqamula i-USB kunye namandla kwi-Y1 yakho, emva koko ucinezele Okulandelayo.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Nqamula i-USB kunye namandla kwi-{model} yakho, emva koko ucinezele Okulandelayo.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Khetha 'Imowudi yokuGcina i-USB' kumdlali wakho.
2. Cofa u 'Browse Folder...' ukukhetha umdlali wakho kwaye ufake imixholo.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Olu lwakhiwo lwe-Rockbox lusebenzisa imixholo engama-240×320, engadityaniswanga. Fumana imixholo yasimahla yomdlali wakho kwindawo yomxholo weRockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Ukuba i-{model} yakho ayiqalisi, qhawula i-USB, ubambe iqhosha lamandla u-10s ukuseta kwakhona, kwaye ulayite amandla. Okanye buyisela isoftware yoqobo.
err_storage_full_desc: Ikhompyuter yakho iphelelwe yindawo. Nceda uvule isithuba sedisk kwidrive yakho kwaye uzame kwakhona.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Inguqulelo endala yoHlaziyo isekule khompyutha kwaye ithatha indawo kwidisk. Ukuyikhupha kukhulula eso sithuba.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Ibango kwakhona malunga ne-{size} yendawo yedisk
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Susa isicelo esidala soHlaziyo lwe-Innioasis kunye neefolda zenkxaso
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Gcina i-Android Platform Tools (ADB / Fastboot) ifakiwe
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ukuba awusebenzisi i-ADB okanye i-Fastboot ngaphandle kwe-Updater, ukukhangela ukukhupha kunye nokubuyisela indawo yokugcina eyongezelelweyo.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ucoca ngempumelelo ufakelo lwelifa kunye nesithuba sediski esibuyiselweyo.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Inguqulelo endala yoHlaziyo isekho kule khompyutha. Ukuyikhupha kukhulula isithuba sedisk.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Oku kususa ngokupheleleyo i-app endala, i-firmware ekhutshelweyo, kunye neefayile ezishiyekileyo.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Susa izixhobo ze-Android Platform (ADB / Fastboot) ngokunjalo? Khetha Gcina ukuba usebenzisa i-ADB.
settings_arm64_driver_note: Inkxaso yeWindows ye-ARM64 ayivavanywanga. Kwiilaptops ze-Snapdragon kunye ne-RTX Spark, i-Zadig ingasetyenziswa kunye nokunyanzeliswa kweSiginesha yoMqhubi ivaliwe ukufaka i-WinUSB okanye i-libusb ye-MT6227 i-Preloader isixhobo kwi-Device Manager. Jonga isikhokelo somqhubi we-ARM64 samanyathelo.
